description:
Assert, against the validation report's own passes, every case the executor-side dangling-link, drift and placeholder unit tests cover, so those executor copies can be deleted without losing a property.

## Background

- The executor-pass unit tests (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:3009-3326`) cover enforces-rule and enforces-gate links, unresolvable qualified ids, explicit kind forms, the named-project form, unqualified links and an invariant link.
- The report's item-link, drift and placeholder tests live in `crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs` (from about `:977`); `jit::test_harness` builds closed images for them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each case the listed executor-pass tests cover is asserted once by a report test built on the shared image builder, with the same expected finding or absence.
- [hard] REQ-02: The report suite passes; the executor-pass tests are left in place.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Report pass tests cover the executor-pass cases
